# testx

> LLM documentation for github.com/go-testx/testx (Go 1.23+).

testx layers typed assertions, declarative Cases, presets, contracts, polling, HTTP/CLI helpers, golden files, benchmarks, and fuzz seeds on Go's standard testing package. Assertions report failures themselves; do not wrap them in if + Fatal/Error. RunErr expects no error unless a Case uses WithError.

## Documentation

- [/overview.md](docs/ai/overview.md): Overview and core rules.
- [/api-reference.md](docs/ai/api-reference.md): Complete public API reference.
- [/recipes.md](docs/ai/recipes.md): Test-generation recipes.
- [/constraints.md](docs/ai/constraints.md): Generation constraints and review checklist.
- [/README.md](README.md): Human-oriented full project documentation, installation, and IDE tooling.

## Quick generation rules

1. Keep standard func TestXxx(t *testing.T) tests.
2. Use Require for prerequisites and Assert for independent checks.
3. Never add t.Fatal/t.Error after a failed testx assertion; it already reported.
4. Match Run, RunErr, or ContextFuncErr to the exact subject signature.
5. Do not invent APIs or business fixtures; fall back to standard testing when needed.
